purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only locks along an arbitrary fixed world-space direction while leaving perpendicular translation unconstrained, with shared one-step composer, activity-gate and component-isolation integration.

properties.locks: bounded explicit body pairs with finite non-zero world-space direction vectors and projected offsets
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: direction does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
shared composer, activity-gate and component collision-isolation paths support direction locks; isolation is component-wide rather than edge-only
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

proves: fixed-direction locks can participate as the appended sixth family around exactly one donor-core integration step while preserving perpendicular freedom and deterministic replay
disabled direction locks are excluded from solving and topology while enabled direction-lock edges participate in explicit component isolation without a second donor-core step

truth.basis: The capability is named and evidenced as a fixed world-space projected translation constraint, not a rotating local-axis or full prismatic joint; guarded activity and component-wide isolation semantics are explicit.

agency.basis: Callers choose body pair, direction, projected offset, activity state, isolation request and bounded solver parameters.

continuity.basis: The donor core remains untouched and the same primitive is reused through composer, guarded activity and isolation paths rather than replaced or silently reimplemented.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The integrated paths reuse one-step composition and deterministic topology instead of chaining standalone wrappers and accidentally integrating physics twice.
